description: Managed ppms.php query and form requests, plus documented JSON bulk query strings. Checks application and visitor identities, flags, performance bounds, custom variables, search categories and nullable eight-position ecommerce rows. Raw text query bodies, flat JSON parameter maps and custom collector domains remain outside this profile.
